C-METADATA-SAVE-SAFETY.IntentSummary: Implement the approved option B as one sequential text-and-format save contract. Preserve canonical editor text, correlate immutable format snapshots, encode exact supported bytes before mutation, and propagate actual open metadata. This completed plan requires owner approval before product implementation.
C-METADATA-SAVE-SAFETY.ExecutionBoundary: Plan inspection baseline is 94db8add579d3a2354c2d2cb9eb0e7a90cce759b. Implementation starts in a clean isolated branch after sequential integration of PRs 214, 215 and 216. Compare the integrated source with those reviewed payloads before writes; metadata-only closeout and the isolated timestamp grammar repair do not change this design. Any material save/open/state drift requires an explicit plan replacement, never editing an approved plan. Execute natively and sequentially, without additional reviewer rounds. Do not change versions, dependencies, release dispatch, tags, publication, accepted app bundles or frozen receipts.
C-METADATA-SAVE-SAFETY.CommandBudgets: Fresh coverage on the preceding Save/Close source took 293 seconds, IPC typecheck 321 milliseconds and renderer build 14 seconds on the reference host. The existing 600/60/180 second lifecycle limits retain headroom. Full Rust and browser tiers below remain separate acceptance commands; no nested lifecycle commands or duplicate focused suites inside TargetAssertions.

Architecture.Decision: Keep one complete document model and the existing save coordinator. Format setters update options and document revision, never serialize/import a surface or rewrite canonical Markdown. Remove trailing-newline policy application from LISTEN_FOR_CONTENT_CHANGE; transformations belong exclusively to the byte writer.

A document has a saved canonical-text checkpoint, saved normalized format checkpoint and requiresExplicitSave flag for stale acknowledgements. Ordinary text undo can return to a saved checkpoint only when the format also matches and explicit retry is not owed. Navigation and no-op choices never advance revision. A genuine format change advances the existing contentRevision counter, whose contract becomes the complete document-version counter.

The immutable format value is {encoding: UI encoding ID, isBom: boolean, lineEnding: 'lf'|'crlf'|'mixed', finalNewline: 0|1|3}. Keep legacy tab fields at adapters; mixed source remains mixed until an explicit LF/CRLF action. Value 0 removes trailing CR/LF line breaks only, 1 ensures exactly one output line break even for empty text, 3 preserves the canonical trailing-break count. Normalize CRLF/lone CR to LF once, apply the trailing policy, then render selected LF/CRLF. Never trim question marks or ordinary trailing spaces.

Write request and reply carry the complete format. Validate it together with owner, lifetime, revision and paths. Save As can adopt its own destination while keeping newer format/text dirty. An older successful write records only its dispatched checkpoint and requires an explicit fresh save; a later content/history notification cannot erase that requirement. Failed/cancelled writes establish no checkpoint.

Use one checked-in catalog consumed by renderer and Rust tests. UTF-8 and UTF-16 LE/BE have explicit encoders; UTF-16 never calls encoding_rs::Encoding::encode. Other declared codecs reject any had_errors or output-encoding mismatch before producing a successful byte vector. Preserve sandbox/bookmark/path and live-owner collision validation, then use a byte-oriented version of the existing fsync writer. This is not atomic replacement or physical-write scheduling.

For normal open routes, read bytes with the existing regular-file/access/size boundaries, decode with actual metadata and propagate it through build_open_new_tab_payload. Infer no richer encoding heuristics. Keep exact decoded canonical text; LF, CRLF, mixed and lone-CR classification is explicit. Lossy decode or a detected unsupported write codec cannot silently overwrite the source; surface a safe read/save error. Existing dirty-tab reuse keeps its live options and checkpoints.

Extend the existing session snapshot with lastSessionFormats for named open paths: selected format and its format-dirty indication only, no text, transient tokens or history payloads. Restore onto freshly opened text and detected disk format, marking a pending chosen format dirty; never trust an old session saved-format value as proof of current disk bytes. Keep tab order/active/root restoration unchanged. Untitled crash recovery remains outside this item. Retain chosen options across in-memory recently-closed recovery and mode switches.

CodecCatalog.Storage: src/common/fileFormatCatalog.json has exactly one entry per existing ENCODING_NAME_MAP key, with id, backend label or explicit codec kind, supported boolean and unavailable reason key. Tests compare the exact 36-key sets and backend dispositions. BOM is supported only for UTF-8 and UTF-16 LE/BE; a true BOM for any other codec is a pre-write policy error.
CodecCatalog.Unicode: utf8: explicit UTF-8; utf16be: explicit UTF-16 big endian; utf16le: explicit UTF-16 little endian. Each supports with/without BOM, including supplementary scalars.
CodecCatalog.SingleByteExact: ascii retains its visible ISO 8859-1 meaning and uses an explicit U+0000..U+00FF codec, not WHATWG windows-1252. latin5 retains its visible ISO 8859-9 meaning and uses the exact ISO map: identity except bytes D0/DD/DE/F0/FD/FE map to U+011E/U+0130/U+015E/U+011F/U+0131/U+015F; displaced Icelandic scalars are unrepresentable. No silent superset substitution.
CodecCatalog.Mapped: latin3=ISO-8859-3; iso885915=ISO-8859-15; cp1252=windows-1252; arabic=ISO-8859-6; cp1256=windows-1256; latin4=ISO-8859-4; cp1257=windows-1257; iso88592=ISO-8859-2; windows1250=windows-1250; cp866=IBM866; iso88595=ISO-8859-5; koi8r=KOI8-R; koi8u=KOI8-U; cp1251=windows-1251; iso885913=ISO-8859-13; greek=ISO-8859-7; cp1253=windows-1253; hebrew=ISO-8859-8; cp1255=windows-1255; cp1254=windows-1254; gb18030=gb18030; gbk=GBK; big5=Big5; shiftjis=Shift_JIS; eucjp=EUC-JP; euckr=EUC-KR; latin6=ISO-8859-10. These use the installed encoding_rs implementation with strict encode-result checks and exact fixtures, not untested UI-label lookup.
CodecCatalog.Unavailable: utf32be and utf32le: no established native decode/write contract; gb2312: the available GBK encoder is not proof of strict GB2312 output; big5hkscs: a Big5 alias is not proof of full Big5-HKSCS support. These four remain visible with localized unavailable explanations and cannot be applied as a working format or selected as a new default. A stored unsupported default is surfaced and refused, not silently rewritten or migrated. Selecting a supported alternative is explicit.
CodecCatalog.Presentation: Use the existing encoding palette and Preferences list. Supported Unicode variants expose explicit with/without BOM choices. Unavailable entries have an explanation and no mutating action; their dispatch path also refuses defensively. Do not add an encoding-redetection screen. Map backend detection labels back to the catalog's UI IDs; aliases with identical codecs use a deterministic supported ID. Native menus and status summaries reflect the same current format.
CodecCatalog.References: https://docs.rs/encoding_rs/0.8.44/encoding_rs/struct.Encoding.html ; https://www.unicode.org/Public/MAPPINGS/ISO8859/8859-9.TXT . The installed crate source and fixture bytes are authoritative for implementation; web documentation never replaces byte tests.

Interfaces.Interface: documentFormat.js exports captureDocumentFormat(tab) -> immutable DocumentFormat, sameDocumentFormat(a,b) -> boolean, recomputeDocumentSaved(tab) -> boolean and applyDocumentFormat(tab,patch) -> changed boolean. The caller first checks inspectDocumentComposition for the target. Tab state owns savedMarkdown:string, savedFormat:DocumentFormat and requiresExplicitSave:boolean; real effective changes advance contentRevision once.

DocumentWriteRequest.format and DocumentWriteReply.format are required DocumentFormat values, with no permissive missing-format default for the correlated command. Snapshot format is captured after pending owned model edits and after a picker. documentSave.ts forwards a defensive complete copy. Coordinator sameVersion includes sameDocumentFormat; ACK validation checks the echoed format before any saved/path mutation.

m014_encoding.rs owns serializable DocumentFormat, encode_document(markdown:&str,format:&DocumentFormat)->Result<Vec<u8>,String>, codec catalog lookup and decode_document(bytes:&[u8])->Result<DecodedDocument,String>. DecodedDocument carries canonical text, UI encoding ID, BOM presence and EOL classification. Unknown codec, invalid policy, unsupported codec and unrepresentable text have stable distinct error codes without logging content.

m013b::fs::fs_write_bytes_inner(path:&str,bytes:&[u8],sandbox:&Path)->Result<(),IpcError> reuses check_path, parent creation, write_all and sync_all. Existing fs_write_inner retains its text signature by delegating with UTF-8 bytes. The correlated writer constructs the full bytes first and echoes the exact validated format only after a successful write; deprecated save-only endpoints keep their documented compatibility boundary.

build_open_new_tab_payload keeps its existing caller-facing signature and access routing. Its byte-read/decode helper returns actual metadata, canonical decoded text, isMixedLineEndings and finalNewline=3 without normalizing mixed input. Existing emit/open/link/session routes consume the same payload; no second unvalidated open route is introduced.

ReviewFocus.Case: A stale write whose text/format were later changed and reverted must still require explicit retry; history or a caret notification cannot clean it (T-002).
The ASCII-named UI ID actually says ISO 8859-1, and ISO 8859-9 differs from Windows-1254. C1 controls, displaced Icelandic letters and Turkish letters pin exact mappings (T-001).
Empty input, trailing question marks, lone CR, CRLF, mixed line breaks and multiple trailing breaks must not be silently damaged or double-converted (T-001/T-003).
A cached unsupported default, mixed-source file or session-restored format-only dirty tab must not become an implicit UTF-8 save or a clean close (T-002/T-003).
A background tab, cancelled picker, rejected encoding and newly active IME must preserve the original document set, owned text, preedit and prior on-disk bytes (T-002/T-004).

T-001.Title: Define the codec catalog and exact prevalidated byte writer
T-001.Files: Create common/fileFormatCatalog.json and util/documentFormat.js pure format normalization/equality; modify common/encoding.js, m014_encoding.rs, m013b/fs.rs and the format fields of m001_save_close.rs. Add util/document-format.test.js and inline Rust byte/sentinel tests. Update owned M-001/M-002/M-014 and verification projections.

Steps.Step: Write red byte tests: UTF-8 text A+emoji with/without EFBBBF; UTF-16 LE/BE exact surrogate bytes with/without FFFE/FEFF; representable CP1251 Cyrillic; all 36 catalog dispositions; ISO8859-1 C1 and Latin5 Turkish/displaced letters. For each supported mapped codec pin at least one non-ASCII byte fixture and strict round-trip.

Pin final-newline policies 0/1/3 on empty text, A, A followed by one/multiple breaks and literal trailing question marks; LF/CRLF/lone CR and mixed rejection; no doubled CR. Invalid codec/policy, BOM on non-Unicode and emoji in CP1251 leave an existing sentinel byte-identical and create no new target or parent.

Implement the exact interfaces and catalog above without new dependencies. Encode completely before the filesystem mutation boundary, reject encoding_rs had_errors/output mismatch, and retain existing sandbox/bookmark and collision guards. Update Rust request construction in owned tests; preserve legacy text facade signatures.

Run focused red/green commands and record fixture results; synchronize module contracts, maps, markers and graph/verification. Markers record codec/error/version identities without document text or raw private paths.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-004..R-006 and AC-003: supported codecs emit exact declared bytes; all 36 IDs have one explicit disposition; every prevalidation failure occurs before filesystem mutation. No atomic-I/O guarantee is claimed.

Parameterize native-menu/bus and palette routes; active composition refuses before capture/import or policy mutation.

Forward required format through TypeScript DTO and runtime adapter, validate it in coordinator replies and backend request/reply. Update doubles and consumer assertions to the explicit contract. Present supported BOM variants and unavailable-choice explanations in existing palette/Preferences; defensive store dispatch rejects invalid choices without silently changing stored preferences. Localize added feedback in every current locale.

Run focused red/green suites, IPC typecheck and existing save/close unit regressions. Repair obsolete tests only where they assert this item's known-defect behavior; do not weaken unrelated characterizations or test thresholds.

Steps.Step: Write native temp-file open-payload tests for UTF8 BOM, UTF16 LE/BE BOM, CRLF, mixed EOL, empty input and a deterministic detector-selected non-UTF fixture. Implement the shared decoded-metadata open payload for existing picker/sidebar/CLI/link/reopen/session routes, retaining their access checks and regular-file/size limits. Extend _sessionSnapshot/_saveSessionState and restore with validated lastSessionFormats records scoped to named session paths. Persist selected formats and dirty intent without document text/tokens. Fresh disk metadata stays the actual saved checkpoint, so a pending restored choice remains dirty even after text undo or external disk change. Treat old sessions without the new field as normal metadata-aware opens.
